definitions.full: H8597. tipharah תִּפְאָרָה noun feminine beauty, glory ; — ׳תּ Isa 28:5 ; Jer 48:17 ; elsewhere absolute and construct תִּפְאֶרֶת Isa 3:18 20 t.; תִּפְאָ֑רֶת Prov 28:12 6 t.; suffix תִּפְאַרְתִּי Isa 46:13 20t. suffix; — 1 beauty, finery Isa 3:18 ; of garments 52:1 ; jewels Ezek 16:17 , 39 ; 23:26 , compare 2Chr 3:6 ; flock Jer 13:20 ; a man Isa 44:13 ; city of Samaria 28:1 , 4 ; diadem 28:5 . 2 glory: a. of rank: apparel of high priest Exod 28:2 , 40 (P); ת ׳עֲטֶרֶת crown of glory Prov 4:9 ; 16:31 ; Isa 62:3 ; Jer 13:18 ; Ezek 16:12 ; 23:42 ; greatness of monarch Est 1:4 ; house of David and inhabitants of Jerusalem Zech 12:7 (twice in verse). b. of renown ולת ׳לְשֵׁם Deut 26:19 ; 1Chr 22:5 ; Jer 13:11 ; 33:9 . c. attribute of ׳י Psa 71:8 ; 1Chr 29:11 ; ת ׳שֵׁם Isa 63:14 ; 1Chr 29:13 ; ׳ת עֹז Psa 89:18 ; ת ׳זְרוֺעַ Isa 63:12 ; hence ׳ת in ׳י s sanctuary Psa 96:6 , תִּפְאַרְתִּ ׳בֵּית Isa 60:7 ; compare 63:15 (of heavenly temple), 64:10 ; ׳ת as ׳י s gift to Israel 46:13 ; compare 60:19 (also Psa 89:18 above); of future fruit of land 4:2 ; designation of ark of ׳י 78:61 . 3. a. honour of nation Israel Lam 2:1 . b. glorying, boasting , of individual, Isa 20:5 ; Prov 17:6 ; 19:11 ; 20:29 ; 28:12 ; warrior Judg 4:9 ; monarchs Isa 10:12 ; nations 13:19 ; Ezek 24:25 , ת ׳מַקֵּל rod (sceptre) of glorying Jer 48:17 (others 1 ). II. פאר (doubtful √).
